verification.description: Ii-akhawunti ezintsha ziqinisekisa idilesi ye-imeyile yazo phambi kokuba zikwazi ukungena. Ii-akhawunti ezenziwe phambi kokuba uvule oku azithintelwa.
verification.needTest: Qala uthumele i-imeyile yovavanyo ephumeleleyo, ukuze amakhonkco afikelele ebantwini.

gmail.step1: Vula i-2-Step Verification kwi-akhawunti ye-Google oza kuthumela ngayo.
gmail.step2: Yenza iphasiwedi ye-app ebizwa ngokuba yi-{storeName}, uze ukhuphele iphasiwedi enoonobumba aba-16. I-Google iyibonisa kanye kuphela.
gmail.step3: Faka iseva ne-port apha ngentla, idilesi yakho epheleleyo ye-Gmail njengegama lomsebenzisi, kunye nephasiwedi ye-app njengephasiwedi.
gmail.step4: Ukuthumela njengenye idilesi, umz. info@yourstore.com, qala uyongeze kwi-Gmail phantsi kwe-Settings → Accounts and Import → Send mail as.
gmail.caution: I-akhawunti ye-Gmail yobuqu ithumela ukuya kuthi ga kwii-imeyile ezingama-500 ngosuku, i-Google Workspace ukuya kwi-2000. Ivenkile exakekileyo idinga inkonzo yokuthumela ii-imeyile.

zoho.step1: Sebenzisa smtppro.zoho.com kwidilesi ekwidomeyini yakho, okanye smtp.zoho.com kwidilesi egqibela nge-@zoho.com.
zoho.step2: Usebenzisa ukungena ngamanyathelo amabini? Yenza iphasiwedi ye-app phantsi kwe-Security → App Passwords uze uyisebenzise njengephasiwedi.
zoho.step3: Faka iseva ne-port 587 apha ngentla, nedilesi yakho epheleleyo ye-Zoho njengegama lomsebenzisi.
zoho.caution: I-akhawunti ekomnye ummandla isebenzisa iseva yaloo mmandla, umz. smtppro.zoho.in okanye smtppro.zoho.eu.

hosting.step1: Kwi-cPanel, vula i-Email Accounts uze ucofe i-Connect Devices ecaleni kwedilesi oza kuthumela ngayo.
hosting.step2: Phantsi kwe-Secure SSL/TLS Settings, khuphela i-Outgoing Server ne-SMTP Port.
hosting.step3: Zifake apha ngentla, nedilesi ye-imeyile epheleleyo njengegama lomsebenzisi kunye nephasiwedi yaloo bhokisi ye-imeyile.
hosting.caution: Impazamo yesatifikethi idla ngokuthetha igama leseva elahlukileyo. Sebenzisa eliboniswa yi-cPanel, nokuba likhangeleka ngolu hlobo: server123.yourhost.com.

brevo.step1: Kwi-Brevo, vula i-SMTP & API, emva koko i-SMTP tab, uze ukhuphele igama lokungena le-SMTP. Ligqibela nge-@smtp-brevo.com.
brevo.step2: Cofa i-Generate a new SMTP key uze ukhuphele isitshixo. Iphasiwedi yakho ye-Brevo ayisebenzi apha.
brevo.step3: Yongeza i-imeyile yomthumeli njengomthumeli kwi-Brevo, okanye uqinisekise idomeyini yakho.
brevo.step4: Faka iseva ne-port apha ngentla, igama lokungena le-SMTP njengegama lomsebenzisi kunye nesitshixo njengephasiwedi.
brevo.caution: Uthumela usebenzisa idomeyini yakho? Yongeza iirekhodi ze-SPF ne-DKIM ozinikwa yi-Brevo, kungenjalo ii-imeyile zakho zingangena kwi-spam.

sendgrid.step1: Kwi-SendGrid, vula i-Settings → API Keys uze wenze isitshixo esinemvume ye-Mail Send. I-SendGrid isibonisa kanye kuphela.
sendgrid.step2: Qinisekisa i-imeyile yomthumeli, okanye yonke idomeyini yakho, phantsi kwe-Settings → Sender Authentication.
sendgrid.step3: Faka iseva ne-port apha ngentla. Igama lomsebenzisi ligama elithi apikey, kwaye iphasiwedi sisitshixo.
sendgrid.caution: I-SendGrid iyazala ii-imeyile ezivela kwidilesi yomthumeli engakhange iyiqinisekise.

ses.step1: Kwikhonsoli ye-Amazon SES, qinisekisa idomeyini yakho okanye i-imeyile yomthumeli phantsi kwe-Identities.
ses.step2: Vula i-SMTP settings uze ukhuphele i-SMTP endpoint. Emva koko cofa i-Create SMTP credentials uze ukhuphele igama lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi: ziboniswa kanye kuphela.
ses.step3: Zifake apha ngentla. Izitshixo zakho zofikelelo ze-AWS azisebenzi apha.
ses.caution: I-akhawunti entsha inokuthumela kuphela kwiidilesi eziqinisekisiweyo. Cela i-production access phambi kokuba ivenkile yakho ivulelwe uluntu.

other.step1: Khangela “SMTP settings” kuncedo lomboneleli wakho, okanye ubacele iseva ye-imeyile ephumayo.
other.step2: Faka iseva apha ngentla ne-port 587, okanye 465. Phepha i-port 25: iinethiwekhi ezininzi ziyayivala.
other.step3: Igama lomsebenzisi lidla ngokuba yidilesi yakho epheleleyo ye-imeyile. Ukuba umboneleli wakho unika iiphasiwedi ze-app, sebenzisa enye.
other.caution: I-Outlook.com ne-Hotmail zayeka ukwamkela iiphasiwedi ze-akhawunti ezivela kwezinye ii-app ngo-2024. I-Microsoft 365 isazamkela, kodwa i-Microsoft iza kukuvala oku ngokumiselweyo ekupheleni kuka-2026, ngoko inkonzo yokuthumela ii-imeyile lolona khetho lukhuselekileyo.

fix.title: Ukuba uvavanyo luyasilela
fix.intro: Khangela la magama kwimpazamo ebonakala phantsi kwekhadi elithi Iseva ye-imeyile.
fix.login: Igama lomsebenzisi okanye iphasiwedi ayichanekanga. I-Gmail, ne-Zoho enokungena ngamanyathelo amabini, zifuna iphasiwedi ye-app, hayi iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti.

oauth.title: I-OAuth / Ukungena Kwe-Social

google.label: Ukungena nge-Google
google.description: Vumela abasebenzisi ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti ye-Google
google.step1: Vula i-Google Cloud Console ukhethe iprojekthi ekhoyo, okanye wenze entsha yale venkile.
google.step2: Phantsi kwe-APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, gcwalisa igama losetyenziso, i-imeyile yenkxaso kunye nedomeyini egunyazisiweyo, uze upapashe usetyenziso. Ngelixa lusekwi-Testing, ngabasebenzisi bovavanyo obabhalileyo kuphela abanokungena.
google.step3: Yiya ku-Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID uze ukhethe i-Web application njengohlobo.
google.step6: Khuphela i-Client ID ne-Client secret kwiindawo ezingasentla, ugcine, uze ucofe u-Qinisekisa iinkcukacha. Abathengi abatsha be-Google banokuthatha imizuzu embalwa ngaphambi kokuba basebenze.

facebook.label: Ukungena nge-Facebook
facebook.description: Vumela abasebenzisi ukuthi bangene nge-akhawunti ye-Facebook
facebook.step1: Vula i-Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create app, uze ukhethe injongo “Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”.
facebook.step2: Yongeza imveliso ye-Facebook Login kusetyenziso, uze uvule i-Facebook Login → Settings.
facebook.step3: Vula i-Client OAuth login ne-Web OAuth login, uze wongeze oku phantsi kwe-Valid OAuth Redirect URIs:
facebook.step4: Kwi-App settings → Basic, misela i-Site URL ibe
facebook.step4c: phantsi kwe-App domains. I-Meta ikwafuna i-URL yoMgaqo-nkqubo wabucala ngaphambi kokuba usetyenziso lube semoyeni.
facebook.step5: Khuphela i-App ID ne-App Secret kwiindawo ezingasentla, ugcine, uze ucofe u-Qinisekisa iinkcukacha.
facebook.step6: Tshintsha usetyenziso ukusuka ku-Development uye ku-Live. Ude wenze njalo, ngabantu abanendima kusetyenziso kuphela abanokungena nge-Facebook.

oauth.envCredentials: Iinkcukacha zalo mboneleli zisetwe ngee-environment variables — yivule ukuze zisebenze.
oauth.originMismatch: Ukhangela ku-{browser}, kodwa ukungena kusebenza nge-{configured}. Bhalisa ii-URL ezibonisiweyo apha ngezantsi — okanye ubhekise i-BETTER_AUTH_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL kwidomeyini oyisebenzisayo ngokwenene.
oauth.redirectUriHint: Yincamathelise kwikhonsoli yomboneleli kanye njengoko ibonakala — nawuphi na umahluko, nokuba ngu-slash ekugqibeleni, wenza ukungena kwaliwe.
oauth.httpsRequiredGoogle: I-Google yamkela kuphela i-redirect URI ye-HTTPS (into ekhethiweyo kuphela ngu-http://localhost). Vula eli phepha kwidomeyini yakho esebenzayo ngaphambi kokuyibhalisa.
oauth.httpsRequiredFacebook: I-Meta yamkela kuphela i-redirect URI ye-HTTPS eluntwini — i-localhost iyaliwa. Vula eli phepha kwidomeyini yakho esebenzayo, okanye kutshunele lwe-HTTPS, ngaphambi kokuyibhalisa.
oauth.verifyHint: Ukuqinisekisa kuvavanya i-ID nemfihlo kumboneleli. Ukuba i-redirect URI ibhalisiwe kusiba nobungqina kuphela ngokungena kokwenyani.

localRetired.title: Indawo yokugcina yasekuhlaleni isusiwe
localRetired.body: Iifayile esele zikule seva ziyaqhubeka zilayisha, kodwa ulayisho olutsha lufuna omnye wababoneleli abangezantsi. Khetha omnye, ufake iinkcukacha zakhe, uze uvule “Fudusa iifayile onazo kakade” — kukho imiyalelo kunye nokugcinwa okufuneka ukwenze phambi kokuthunyelwa okulandelayo.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: Kwideshbhodi ye-Cloudflare vula i-R2 → Create bucket. Igama layo lifakwa kwiGama lebhakethi apha ngentla.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, imvume Object Read & Write, ibekelwe loo bhakethi kuphela. Khuphela zombini iindawo kwi-Access Key ID nakwi-Secret Access Key apha ngentla — imfihlo iboniswa kanye kuphela.
cloudflare_r2.account: Khuphela i-Account ID eneempawu ezingama-32 kwibha esecaleni yephepha le-R2 uyifake kwi-R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Ibhakethi → Settings → Public access: vula i-subdomain ye-r2.dev okanye udibanise idomeyini yakho, uze uncamathisele elo dilesi kwi-URL yoluntu.
cloudflare_r2.test: Cofa uVavanyo lonxibelelwano, uze ugcine. Uvavanyo lulayisha ifayile yovavanyo luze luyifunde kwakhona nge-public URL, ngoko luyasilela ukuba unqumle inyathelo elidlulileyo.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Ngaphandle kwe-URL yoluntu wonke umfanekiso wemveliso ubuyisela u-403 kwibhrawuza nangona iinkcukacha zokungena zibonakala zilungile — iifayile zisuka kwi-endpoint yabucala ye-R2, engafundekiyo ngaphandle kokungena. Idomeyini yakho ingcono kune-r2.dev: i-CDN ye-Cloudflare iphendula izicelo ezigciniweyo ingayibizi mali ibhakethi.

s3.bucket: Yenza ibhakethi kwikhonsoli ye-S3 uze uqaphele ummandla wayo — kufuneka ufane nommandla okhethwe apha ngentla.
s3.iam: IAM → yenza umsebenzisi onofikelelo lweenkqubo kunye nomgaqo onika ezi zenzo kuloo bhakethi:
s3.public: Vumela ukufundwa ngabantu ngomgaqo webhakethi, okanye ubeke i-CloudFront ngaphambili, uze uncamathisele idilesi efumanekayo kwi-URL yoluntu.
s3.test: Ncamathisela isibini sezitshixo apha ngentla, ucofe uVavanyo lonxibelelwano, uze ugcine.
s3.caution: Iibhakethi ezintsha zifika i-Block all public access ivuliwe. Yiyeke ivuliwe kuphela ukuba usebenzisa i-CloudFront — kungenjalo wonke umfanekiso evenkileni uya kubuyisela u-403.

minio.run: Qhuba i-MinIO ecaleni kwe-app — i-Coolify ne-Dokploy zombini zinetemplethi yokucofa kanye. Faka i-volume ku-/data, kungenjalo ukuthunyelwa okulandelayo kuya kuthatha zonke iifayile ezilayishiweyo.
minio.keys: Vula ikhonsoli ye-MinIO (isiqhagamshelanisi 9001 ngokumiselweyo), yenza ibhakethi, uze uye kwi-Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.fields: I-Endpoint URL yidilesi ye-API (isiqhagamshelanisi 9000), ayisiyo ikhonsoli. Ummandla unokuhlala ungu-us-east-1 — i-MinIO ayiwuhoyi. I-URL yoluntu yindawo iibhrawuza ezifikelela kuyo ibhakethi.
minio.caution: Nikezela i-MinIO nge-HTTPS kwi-subdomain yayo. Iibhrawuza zivala umxholo oxubeneyo, ngoko i-endpoint ye-http:// yonakalisa yonke imifanekiso kwivenkile ye-HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Iziko ledatha olikhethayo liyi-endpoint (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), ngoko khetha elikufuphi nabathengi bakho uze ukhethe loo mmandla mnye apha ngentla.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, uze ukhuphele zombini iindawo kwi-Access Key ID nakwi-Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → misela i-File Listing ibe yeyoluntu, okanye uvule i-CDN.
digitalocean.test: Yiyeke i-URL yoluntu ingenanto ukuze unikezele ngqo ukusuka kwi-Space, okanye uncamathisele i-endpoint ye-CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) ukuze unikezele ukusuka emaphethelweni. Emva koko vavanya unxibelelwano uze ugcine.
digitalocean.caution: Igama le-Space liGama lebhakethi apha ngentla, kwaye i-Space ayinakushenxiselwa kwelinye iziko ledatha emva koko — ummandla wayo umiselwa xa uyenza.

migration.title: Fudusa iifayile onazo kakade
migration.intro: Ukukhetha umboneleli kutshintsha kuphela apho iifayile ezintsha eziya khona. Yonke into elayishwe ngaphambili ihlala apho ibikhona kwaye iyaqhubeka ilayisha de uyifudusele.
migration.step1: Misela umboneleli apha ngentla uze ucofe uVavanyo lonxibelelwano — ufuduso lulayisha kuko oko kugciniweyo apha.
migration.step2: Fudusa iinkcukacha zokungena ezigciniweyo ziye kubume bomboneleli ngamnye. Kukhuselekile kuyo nayiphi na inguqulelo, kwaye akwenzi nto emva kokusebenza kanye.
migration.step3: Layisha iifayile zalapha uze ubhale ngokutsha ii-URL zazo kuyo yonke idatabheyisi. Uvavanyo olomileyo ludwelisa yonke ifayile lungabhali nto.
migration.step4: Jonga ivenkile kunye neThala leMidiya. Akukho nto isuswayo kwidiski, ngoko susa iikopi zalapha ngesandla xa imifanekiso isele ivela.
migration.backup: Ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa okulandelayo: ukuba indlela yakho yokuhlaziya ibuyisela ifolda ye-app — ukulayisha nge-cPanel, ukubhala phezu kwe-zip, isikhongozeli esingenayo i-volume — qala ngokukhuphela iifayile zemidiya zisuke kwiseva. Ukutshintsha ifolda kuyazicima.
migration.note: Ifayile engalayishekiyo igcina i-URL yayo yalapha, ngoko ukusebenza okungaphelelanga kushiya ivenkile esebenzayo endaweni yesonakeleyo. Ukuyiphinda kukhuselekile.

Yongeza ibhakethi yabucala, uze usebenzise pnpm db:migrate private-storage ukuze ususe iifayile esele zigciniwe.

Kwi-Cloudflare Dashboard → R2 → ibhakethi yakho → Settings → Public access, vula i-subdomain ye-R2.dev (okanye udibanise idomeyini yakho) uze uncamathisele loo URL apha.

guide.step2: Yiya kwi-Catalog → Data sources → Add items, khetha i-Data feed, emva koko i-Next.

guide.step1: Kwi-Meta Business Manager, vula i-Business settings → Users → System users, uze wongeze i-system user enendima ye-Admin.
guide.step2: Cofa i-Assign assets, khetha i-Catalogs, khetha ikhathalogu yakho uze uvule i-Manage catalog.
guide.step3: Cofa i-Generate new token, khetha i-app yakho, yiseta ingaze iphelelwe lixesha uze uphawule le mvume. Kopa ithokheni:
guide.step4: Kwi-Commerce Manager, vula ikhathalogu uze ukope i-ID yayo, inombolo engaphantsi kwegama layo.
guide.step5: Ncamathisela zombini apha ngentla uze ucofe i-Gcina. Ukuhambelanisa kokuqala kuthumela yonke imveliso; emva koko kuthunyelwa kuphela okutshintshileyo, kwisithuba esimalunga nemizuzu emithathu.
guide.step6: Ukuba le khathalogu inomthombo wedatha wefidi ecwangcisiweyo, wucime kwi-Catalog → Data sources, ukuze mnye kuphela umthombo obhala iimveliso.
guide.caution: Phatha ithokheni njengephasiwedi. Ukuba irhoxisiwe okanye iphelelwe lixesha, ukuhambelanisa okubukhoma kuyanqumama kwaye abalawuli bayaziswa.
